minBound.description: Minimum value of a continuous interval is equal to this value (inclusive).

maxBound.description: Maximum value of a continuous interval is strictly less than this value (inclusive).

title:
This type defines a continuous parameter space, specifying a [min, max] bound on one continuous interval.

Usage Examples:
Setting fields as {minBound: 5.0, maxBound: 20.0} would sample values in the range [5.0, 20.0].
An example of defining a {@link Hp.ParamSpace.Continuous}:
```py
continuous_space = c3.Hp.ParamSpace.Continuous.fromBounds(minBound=5.0, maxBound=20.0)
```
name: Hp.ParamSpace.Continuous
